note: The marks for the accounts in institutional-footer.json's `social` list, keyed by that entry's `mark`. Each value is the CONTENTS of a 24x24 <svg> — paths and nothing else; the package's social-links component supplies the element, its viewBox and the aria-hidden that keeps the glyph out of the link's accessible name. They are drawn with currentColor and no fill of their own, so one copy serves the light and dark footers rather than two files of the wrong colour. They are inlined into the page and never fetched: a mark served from the service's own CDN would report the address of every page on this site to that company, on all 2,077 pages that carry the footer, and there is nothing about five small pictures worth that. These are third-party trademarks, used to link to this university's own accounts on those services, which is what they are for; they are reproduced as each service publishes its plain monochrome glyph and are not restyled, recoloured or redrawn. A service missing from here is not approximated by hand — it is left out, and social-links renders that account as its name instead, which is what Threads does today.
